title: Sketch the team's process from memory
why_matters: Two weeks in, you've heard the team describe their delivery process at least three times — at onboarding, in stand-up, in 1:1s. If you can't sketch it on a single sheet of paper without referring to anything, you don't actually understand it yet. Sketching first, then validating, is faster than reading.
steps: Take a blank sheet of paper or a single doc. Set a 15-minute timer.
Draw the team's end-to-end process from "work arrives" to "work ships". Swimlanes, decisions, handoffs. Use the BPMN basics from the process-map playbook.
When the timer ends, stop. Look at it. Note the parts you guessed.
Show it to two people on the team — one senior IC, one PM. Ask: where am I wrong?
success_criteria: A single-page sketch exists. At least two people have marked it up. You can name the three things you got wrong and why.
reflection_prompt: Where were you most confidently wrong? One sentence on what made you confident, one sentence on what would have warned you.
